summary: @servicetitan/design-system preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x` identifiers, per-scope string-mapping) and, at install time, downloads a Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<VERSION>/<archive>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line blob prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs` (a Bun-only directive that Node cannot load), containing a rotated string-array decoder (`WV8StW` shift-based rotation with a large hex-encoded index table `n7gIxM` and charset-based decoder `hc1jfK9`) — the payload is gated to only run under the freshly-dropped Bun runtime, bypassing Node-based scanners. The package manifest advertises the ServiceTitan Anvil React design system (homepage v1.anvil.servicetitan.com, github:servicetitan/anvil), but the tarball ships only setup.mjs, math_init.js, and a placeholder dist tree — none of which are consistent with a React component library. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape, Bun-only obfuscated payload, and namespace impersonation together match the install-time-rce fingerprint: installing this package auto-executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine under a runtime chosen to defeat inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
